name: Rei Shimizu
source:
Rei exudes a fun-loving and happy-go-lucky aura that maker her incredibly easy to talk to. However, you suspect she's not at all what she seems. Perhaps she's masking her true feelings?

You'll need a lot of energy to keep up with Rei and her old antics!
